name.ja: <ruby>心の灯り<rt>エバー・パートナー</rt></ruby>

requirement.en: You have a card in your Field Zone or a Field Spell Card in your Graveyard.

effect.en: Ritual Summon an EARTH Attribute Galaxy Type monster by shuffling monsters from your opponent's Graveyard into the Deck as material whose total Levels equal or exceed the Level of the monster you Ritual Summon (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material). This turn, you can only attack with EARTH Attribute Galaxy Type monsters.
